choices.why: This is the only truly beige fabric sofa among the candidates; its clean track arms, compact two-seat size and dark tapered legs suit a calm Japandi wall and the dark floor.
At 160x230 cm, this textured natural jute rug is large enough to sit under the sofa and coffee table, and it warms the dark floor with a true natural fiber.
This large, low, round all-wood table with simple splayed legs is pure Japandi, and its warm walnut tone ties the beige sofa to the dark floor without adding metal or black.
This tall rice-paper lantern floor lamp is exactly the paper lamp requested and gives soft light in the corner by the sofa.

The braided money tree is the largest plant offered, with enough height to fill the corner by the balcony glass; it comes in a plastic nursery pot, so it will need a separate ceramic pot to match the request.

answer.why: A beige low-profile sofa, a jute rug, a round walnut table, a paper lantern and one sculptural plant keep the palette to neutrals and natural materials. Together they give the bright white room a serene, uncluttered Japandi look against the dark plank floor.
